thread:
oliver: Heads-up — a handful of inbound HubSpot leads from last night were assigned in our system but never showed up for reps in Salesforce. Sales flagged 12 missing leads. Anyone seen mapping issues like this before? :confused:

maya: saw the alerts from SF-sync that several leads were held by the duplicate-merge rule during sync. That can make them invisible to users until merge resolves. Did enrichment change company/domain data?

harper: yes — enrichment returned a company domain for ~9 of the 12 which triggered SF duplicate detection (existing company with different canonical id). SF rule sets `hold_until_review=true` when potential dup detected. That blocks the owner transfer flow.

salesops-bot: Sync summary: 12 leads from HS->SF queued 2024-10-14T01:12Z. 9 flagged as DUP_POTENTIAL -> held by merge-policy. 3 synced successfully.

oliver: that explains why sales saw them as missing (they were held in SF staging). Short-term fixes? We need to get owners visible immediately or at least notify sales.

maya: suggestions: 1) bypass merge hold for high-SLA inbound leads (only during 00:00-06:00 window) 2) add a HS tag `defer-merge` for leads created by paid campaigns so SF won't auto-hold 3) make our sync surface a placeholder lead record in SF so reps can see it while merge review happens.

harper: bypassing merge policy sounds risky for dup integrity. I like adding `defer-merge` tag at HS ingestion if lead.source == paid and lead.priority == high. That way only high-SLA leads bypass hold. Example HS workflow rule:
```json
{
  "if": "source == 'paid' AND lifecycle_stage == 'lead'",
  "then": "set property defer_merge = true"
}
```

sf-sync-bot: Note: current SF sync honors property `defer_merge` if present and will not set `hold_until_review`. This flag is currently used for event leads; needs to be enabled for inbound-paid mapping.

oliver: ok — short-term plan: maya enable HS workflow to set `defer_merge` for paid inbound, and I'll flip the sync toggle so sf-sync ignores merge-hold when `defer_merge=true`. Then run a one-off push for the 9 held leads.

maya: pushing HS workflow now. Command: `hubspot workflows create --name "defer-merge-paid-inbound" --condition "source=paid" --action "set defer_merge=true" --activate`

harper: I'll toggle sf-sync to respect the flag: `sf-sync set skip_merge_hold=true --filter "defer_merge=true" --env prod` and requeue held leads. Doing a canary requeue for 2 leads first.

salesops-bot: Requeue initiated: 2 canary leads -> delivered to SF visible to owners. Confirmation pending from sales.

maya: sales confirm canary looked good — owners can see records and initial activity log present. Rolling to remaining held leads.

harper: requeue completed: 9 leads delivered and owners visible. Posting job id: requeue-20241014-01. No merge conflicts surfaced in canary or bulk.

oliver: great. Messaging to sales: "We found 9 inbound leads held by SF duplicate merge rules after enrichment added company domains. We've tagged paid inbound leads to defer merge and requeued held leads so owners can see them. If you still see missing leads DM us and we will escalate."

maya: longer term proposals: - coordinate enrichment domain heuristics with SF duplicate rules (tighter canonicalization) - surface a 'staged' placeholder in Salesforce for held leads so owners see them instantly - metric: %inbound_leads_held_by_merge to track impact on SLA

harper: filing ENG ticket to add canonicalization step to enrichment pipeline and to add staged-SF placeholder flow. Also adding alert when held_by_merge > 1% of inbound hourly rate.

oliver: marking incident as P2 (SLA impact for sales visibility). Closing once postmortem with steps and the sales note is posted. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
